I fixed the failure in `build_format_selector` in `youtube_dl/YoutubeDL.py`. `test_youtube_format_selection` now passes, along with the other 13 tests in `test/test_YoutubeDL.py`. I didn't run the rest of the test suite.

In a spec like `a/b,c`, the `/` branch had already added the choice to the list and reset the current selector to `None`. The `,` branch then appended that `None` to the list, and building the selector function crashed on it (`'NoneType' object has no attribute 'type'`).

The `,` branch now appends only when there is a current selector.
